from pathlib import Path
import ast
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u037/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                rr, cc = stack.pop()
                cells.append((rr, cc))
                for nr, nc in ((rr-1,cc),(rr+1,cc),(rr,cc-1),(rr,cc+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                        seen.add((nr,nc))
                        stack.append((nr,nc))
            r0, r1 = min(x[0] for x in cells), max(x[0] for x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x[1] for x in cells), max(x[1] for x in cells)
            obj = [[grid[rr][cc] for cc in range(c0,c1+1)] for rr in range(r0,r1+1)]
            objects.append((c0, obj))
    objects.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    return [sum((obj[r] for _, obj in objects), []) for r in range(len(objects[0][1]))]
'''
p=programs/'task-ae383726.py'
p.write_text(source)
ns={}
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),ns)
